text_block_list.text:
Shortly after the Takarazuka Kinen,
summer camp
arrives. On the surface,
everything appears
business as usual
with Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, her expression occasionally
darkens,
and her depression is too much
to hide.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I really want to help. Симболи Рудольф,
who has
also noticed something is amiss,
encourages me
to support Эйр Грув to
the best of my ability.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With Симболи Рудольф behind me, I work
toward
giving Эйр Грув a comeback
and restoring her
confidence at the
Sapporo Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
